name: decisions-codex
description: Codex bridge for DecisionsAI agentic workflow execution.

interface.shortDescription: Run DecisionsAI workflow tickets through Codex with evidence, steering, and validation callbacks.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the DecisionsAI agentic workflow loop. Codex receives bounded ticket packets, works inside the linked project folder, reports status, changed files, tests, evidence, blockers, steering, waiting, and completion events back to DecisionsAI, and lets the Hermes-backed run ledger retain execution memory.
defaultPrompt: Run this DecisionsAI ticket and report evidence.
Continue this workflow step and return status.
Validate this project against the ticket outcome.
